verdict.rationale: Several documented features point toward concurrent work. Task worktrees are isolated per repository (docs-26), and tasks group multiple sessions and worktrees (docs-32, docs-5). The stack can run on remote workers or bring-your-own compute (docs-31, docs-7). Sessions can be launched from CI, cron or scripts (docs-12), and tasks can be created from Jira, Linear and GitHub tickets (docs-3, docs-16, docs-17). However, no doc explicitly describes running many tasks at once or managing that throughput, and the tutorials and automation guide are framed around 'one task' or 'one session'. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or guide on concurrent or parallel task execution, a dashboard for managing many simultaneous agents, documented concurrency limits or scaling guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of parallel throughput.
